_comments.short_id_length: Only applies when clip_name_format or vod_name_format is title. Ignored for random and timestamp.
_comments.enable_vod_download: Download completed archive VODs. Currently live streams are never downloaded.
_comments.vod_lookback_days: How many days of past broadcast archives to check when VOD download is enabled.
_comments.vod_name_format: Same options as clip_name_format: title, random, or timestamp.
_comments.delete_local_after_upload: Delete local clips and VODs after every rclone remote uploaded them successfully. Requires enable_rclone and rclone_command copy.
